title: Catalog and response ladder for enterprise audit exports and temporal retention exceptions
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit ad-hoc requests that touch logs and metadata (redaction, retention extension, PII mapping, audit exports). Handling each request manually is slow, inconsistent, and risky for compliance. Goal: Create a repeatable intake, cataloging, and weighted-response ladder that reduces triage time, enforces contract SLAs, and automates safe responses for common cases while surfacing high-risk exceptions to Legal/Security.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Intake form fields capture regulated scope (region, retention target, data types, contractual obligations) and map to a risk score
A2: Automated classification groups requests into three lanes (Auto-Resolve, Ops-Assisted, Legal/Escalation) with >85% precision on labeled historical set
A3: For Auto-Resolve lane, system produces a canned plan + timeline and updates customer within 48 hours
A4: For Ops-Assisted lane, a templated remediation checklist and estimated ETA is created and assigned to the appropriate engineer on-call
A5: Escalation lane triggers Legal + Security review with pre-populated case packet and SLAs, and audit trail stored in Console activity logs
A6: Playbook and runbooks published in Confluence and accessible from Linear; product dashboard shows triage throughput and SLA attainment
A7: Minimal acceptable telemetry: triage latency, lane distribution, false-positive rate for auto-resolve, time-to-closure for high-risk items
success_metrics: Reduce median triage time from 4 business days to <24 hours for standard requests
Auto-resolve throughput handles >=40% of incoming requests without manual legal review
SLA attainment for priority enterprise requests >=95% over first quarter after launch
Operator effort per request reduced by 60% for templated categories
approach: We will build a two-part solution: (1) structured intake + classifier that maps free-text requests into a catalog of canonical request types and a risk score; (2) a response ladder that ties types + risk to deterministic actions (auto-resolve scripts, operator checklists, or legal packet generation). The classifier will be trained on historical tickets and augmented with syntactic detectors for PII/PHI and region-flagging. We prefer rule-driven fallback for high-risk indicators. Implementation will be staged: discovery -> prototype intake UI and manual classifier -> automation with scoring -> integrations (Console UI, case generation, GitHub/Grow flow for ops tasks).
deliverables: Canonical request catalog (CSV + Confluence) mapping 30 common request archetypes
Intake form prototype embedded in Support Console + API endpoint
Classifier model + rule set with evaluation on 12 months of historical requests
Response ladder definitions and templated messages (Auto, Ops, Escalate)
Operational runbooks for Ops-Assisted lane and Legal escalation packet template
Dashboard panels in Console for triage metrics and backlog SLOs
Launch comms and customer-facing FAQ for predictable response expectations
